title: CategoryUpdate
description: User-only PATCH /v1/transactions/{txn_id} request (ADR-023, G04). The user sets the category of one of their transactions; it is stored with classifier "user", wins over any model, survives re-imports and is audited as CATEGORY_CHANGED. The kind and the amount never change, so the categories a transaction can take depend on its kind: a purchase, fee or refund takes a spending category, movement or savings; an income takes income, movement or savings (money back from the holder's savings, ADR-036); a card_payment takes only movement. Any other value is INVALID_INPUT (422) listing the allowed ones in common/envelope; a transaction that is not the caller's, or does not exist, is 404 with an INSUFFICIENT_DATA envelope (missing ["transaction"]), the same for both. The response's data is one transaction as in outputs/transactions. Not an agent tool.

session_id.description: Recorded on the audit event; defaults to "default".
